references.text: The first time a gold bowl weighing ten shekels and filled with incense is mentioned in connection with Nahshon's offering. The same wording and offering are repeated for each tribal leader.
An identical offering of a gold bowl filled with incense from Netanel's gift on behalf of the tribe of Issachar.
Summary of all twelve gold bowls, each weighing ten shekels and filled with incense—a total of 120 shekels of gold.
Instructions regarding the holy incense to be used in the tabernacle. The incense in the gold bowls was intended for service at the altar.
The bowls (kaffot) are mentioned as part of the tabernacle's furnishings, made of pure gold.
Gold bowls full of incense representing the prayers of the saints—a New Testament parallel to the incense offering.
Incense mixed with the prayers of the saints on the golden altar, linking the incense offering to intercession.
